title: Speaking — Morning routines
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on morning routines.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
What is the first thing you usually do after waking up?

part2.topic: Describe a morning when you had to change your usual plans.
points: what made you change your plans
part2.closing: and explain how the change affected the rest of your day.

questions: Why do some people prefer to work early in the morning?
Should schools and employers let people choose their starting times?
How has everyday life connected with morning routines changed for people of different ages?
